subject: Mathematics
topic: Whole numbers, ratios, rates and finance

items.q: What is the value of the 7 in 4 572?
items.qAf: Wat is die waarde van die 7 in 4 572?
items.explain: The 7 is in the hundreds place, so its value is 700.
items.explainAf: Die 7 is in die honderde-plek, dus is die waarde 700.

items.qAf: Rond 6 485 af tot die naaste honderd.
items.explain: The tens and units (85) are more than 50, so round up to 6 500.
items.explainAf: Die tiene en eenhede (85) is meer as 50, dus rond op na 6 500.

items.q: Share R120 in the ratio 2 : 3. How much is the larger share?
items.qAf: Verdeel R120 in die verhouding 2 : 3. Hoeveel is die groter deel?
items.explain: There are 5 parts; R120 ÷ 5 = R24 per part; the larger share is 3 × R24 = R72.
items.explainAf: Daar is 5 dele; R120 ÷ 5 = R24 per deel; die groter deel is 3 × R24 = R72.

items.q: A car travels 240 km in 3 hours. What is its average speed?
items.qAf: ’n Motor ry 240 km in 3 ure. Wat is die gemiddelde spoed?

items.q: An item costs R250 before VAT. VAT is 15%. What is the price including VAT?
items.qAf: ’n Item kos R250 voor BTW. BTW is 15%. Wat is die prys insluitend BTW?
items.explain: 15% of R250 is R37.50, so the total is R250 + R37.50 = R287.50.
items.explainAf: 15% van R250 is R37,50, dus is die totaal R250 + R37,50 = R287,50.

items.q: Sharing R60 in the ratio 1 : 2 gives R20 and R40.
items.qAf: Om R60 in die verhouding 1 : 2 te deel, gee R20 en R40.
items.explain: True. 1 + 2 = 3 parts; R60 ÷ 3 = R20 per part.
items.explainAf: Waar. 1 + 2 = 3 dele; R60 ÷ 3 = R20 per deel.
